# infrawrench_network_flow_report (Resource)

A saved network flow report: bytes and estimated cost of network traffic over a window, by flow pair, endpoint, traffic class, peer service, zone or region pair, account or VPC, with the top talking pairs. Every cost is an estimate at the provider's list rate for the boundary crossed, read from the flows Infrawrench collects (turn collection on with `infrawrench_network_flow_settings`). Flows are kept for 90 days.

Reports file into the same folder tree as cost reports (`infrawrench_cost_report_folder`) and are shared with `infrawrench_object_sharing` using `object_type = "network_flow_report"`.

Set either `date_preset`, or both `date_from` and `date_to`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "infrawrench_cost_report_folder" "network" {
  name = "Network"
}

# Cross-zone and cross-region traffic out of one VPC, by flow pair, per day.
resource "infrawrench_network_flow_report" "cross_zone_pairs" {
  name            = "Cross-zone traffic by pair"
  folder_id       = infrawrench_cost_report_folder.network.id
  date_preset     = "30d"
  granularity     = "daily"
  group_by        = "pair"
  metric          = "both"
  networks        = ["vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f60718"]
  traffic_classes = ["cross_zone", "cross_region"]
}

# Internet egress per week over a fixed window, the heaviest 50 sources.
resource "infrawrench_network_flow_report" "egress_by_source" {
  name            = "Internet egress by source"
  folder_id       = infrawrench_cost_report_folder.network.id
  date_from       = "2026-08-01"
  date_to         = "2026-09-30"
  granularity     = "weekly"
  group_by        = "source"
  metric          = "cost"
  top_n           = 50
  traffic_classes = ["internet_egress", "nat_gateway"]
  directions      = ["egress"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, 1–120 characters.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (Set of String) Connected account ids, e.g. `infrawrench_account.prod.id`. Without it, Kubernetes cluster traffic is left out (a cloud flow log already counts it); naming a cluster's account includes it. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `date_from` (String) First day of a fixed window, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Requires `date_to`.
- `date_preset` (String) A window relative to each run, one of `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `mtd`, `last_month`, `qtd`, `ytd`, `6m`, `12m`. Conflicts with `date_from` / `date_to`.
- `date_to` (String) Last day of a fixed window, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Requires `date_from`. A report covers at most 366 days.
- `description` (String) Free text shown under the title. At most 2000 characters.
- `destination_refs` (Set of String) Destination endpoints by flow ref: a provider resource id, a workload, `internet`, or a service token such as `aws:s3`. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `directions` (Set of String) Directions relative to the observing endpoint, any of `egress`, `ingress`. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `folder_id` (String) Id of the `infrawrench_cost_report_folder` the report is filed in. Clearing it moves the report to the top level.
- `granularity` (String) Bucket size, one of `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`. Defaults to `daily`. There is no hourly: flows are stored one row per day. Weeks start on Monday.
- `group_by` (String) Grouping, one of `none`, `pair`, `source`, `destination`, `traffic_class`, `service`, `zone_pair`, `region_pair`, `account`, `network`. Defaults to `none`. `service` is the peer's provider service (the destination of egress, the source of ingress); `network` is the local side's VPC.
- `metric` (String) What the report shows, one of `cost`, `bytes`, `both`. Defaults to `both`. `bytes` ranks groups and pairs by bytes; the others rank by estimated cost.
- `networks` (Set of String) VPC / network ids (`vpc-0abc…`), matched at either end of a flow. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `regions` (Set of String) Provider regions, matched at either end of a flow. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `resource_types` (Set of String) The peer's resource type id (`ec2-instance`). Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `services` (Set of String) The peer's provider service (`s3`, `dynamodb`). Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `source_refs` (Set of String) Source endpoints by flow ref: a provider resource id (`i-0abc…`), a Kubernetes workload (`namespace/Kind/name`) or a class token. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `top_n` (Number) Groups and top talking pairs listed, 1–200. Omit for the default of 25.
- `traffic_classes` (Set of String) Boundaries crossed, any of `intra_zone`, `cross_zone`, `cross_region`, `internet_egress`, `internet_ingress`, `nat_gateway`, `private_interconnect`, `provider_service`, `unknown`. Intra-region VPC peering is billed, and classified, as `cross_zone`; transit gateway, VPN and interconnect traffic is `private_interconnect`. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.
- `zones` (Set of String) Availability zone ids (`use1-az1`), matched at either end of a flow. Omit for no filter. When set: 1–200 values.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned report id. Use it with `terraform import`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is in the --json output of the Infrawrench CLI
# (`infrawrench network-reports --json`).
terraform import infrawrench_network_flow_report.example 7b8c9d0e-1f2a-3b4c-5d6e-7f8a9b0c1d2e
```
